answer.reason: The verses tell of Sanballat's opposition to the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall, with several distinct episodes that can be named as deeds.

clauses.english: mocked the Jews when they built the wall of Jerusalem
clauses.quote: he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

clauses.english: conspired with others to fight against Jerusalem and hinder the work
clauses.quote: conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

clauses.english: sent Nehemiah messages and an open letter, plotting mischief against him
clauses.quote: Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono.

doubts: NEH 13:28 (his son-in-law, a priest's son) is a relation and was left out as not a deed of his own.
NEH 6:12 hiring of Shemaiah was left out to keep to the chief things.
